media.title: Bolszewik — Polish anti-Bolshevik propaganda poster
media.description: Polish anti-Bolshevik recruiting poster from the Polish–Soviet War, showing Red Army soldiers looting a church and murdering a priest, above the slogan “Jeśli chcesz by bolszewik nie bezcześcił ci kościołów i nie mordował kapłanów idź do wojska jako ochotnik!” (If you do not want the Bolshevik to desecrate your churches and murder your priests, join the army as a volunteer!). Historical context for Kaper’s Warsaw years.
media.altText: Polish propaganda poster showing soldiers with red stars plundering a church altar over the body of a priest, with a call to volunteer for the army printed beneath.
media.rightsNote: Public domain: Biblioteka Narodowa / Polona classify this 1920 poster as Domena Publiczna (public domain). Reproduced as a historical context image with attribution to Biblioteka Narodowa / Polona.

timelineEvents.title: War
timelineEvents.label: 1920 · Polish–Soviet War service
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper serves as a volunteer in the Polish–Soviet War before returning to university life.
timelineEvents.longDescription: Serves as a volunteer in the Polish-Soviet War in the rank of Senior Private (starszy szeregowy) in the Reserve Depot (Skadrowany Zapasowy) of the 1st Reconnaissance Aviation Regiment (1. Pułk Lotniczy Wywiadowczy), stationed at Mokotów, Warsaw. On November 5, he is granted indefinite leave as an “academic volunteer” (akademik ochotnik), allowing him to resume his university studies.
